about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Nikki Budzinski

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2102, MAJOR RICHARD STAR ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2102, MAJOR RICHARD STAR ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 2102, the Major Richard Star Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONWIDE CONSUMER AND FUEL RETAILER CHOICE ACT OF 2025
statements.title: NATIONWIDE CONSUMER AND FUEL RETAILER CHOICE ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 1346, the Nationwide Consumer and Fuel Retailer Choice Act, as amended.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TIPPED EMPLOYEE PROTECTION ACT
statements.title: TIPPED EMPLOYEE PROTECTION ACT
sentences: This legislation would allow her employer to average her tipped wage from waiting tables with the standard minimum wage she earned during her back-of-the-house hours.
In a time of rising costs and an uncertain economy and working families all across my district struggling to make ends meet, this bill to reduce take-home pay for workers is tone-deaf, at best.

My amendment would attach the Wage Theft Prevention and Wage Recovery Act to this bill, which would establish new and increased penalties for violations of overtime and minimum wage requirements, a real commonsense solution for working people.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong opposition to this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LOWERING COSTS FOR WORKING FAMILIES
statements.title: LOWERING COSTS FOR WORKING FAMILIES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today on behalf of lowering costs for working families in my district who deserve better than to be ripped off by big corporations.
Because when inflation is crushing families, we won't let big corporations squeeze people who are just trying to get by. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THANKING LAURA FALENDER
statements.title: THANKING LAURA FALENDER
sentences: These include, but are certainly not limited to, the VA Mental Health Engagement Act, the Improving Veterans' Experience Act of 2025, and the Edith Nourse Rogers STEM Scholarship Opportunity Act, which unanimously passed the House of Representatives earlier this year.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEVASTATING HARM CAUSED BY TRUMP ADMINISTRATION
statements.title: DEVASTATING HARM CAUSED BY TRUMP ADMINISTRATION
sentences: I rise today for my district, for our economy, for our workers, and for our clean energy future.
These funds would have reduced emissions from this plant by 99 percent.
It is canceling tax credits to help union workers find jobs and to help working people keep the lights on.
The only thing this bill does is hand out tax breaks to billionaires while making it harder for working people to get by.
As we know, the bill canceled tax credits designed to lower people's energy bills, transform our Nation's clean energy economy, and create thousands of good-paying union jobs.
The administration called these investments wasteful spending.
Good-paying union jobs are not a waste.
Building the clean energy infrastructure of tomorrow right here in America is not a waste.
Across the country, there were thousands of clean energy projects planned, underway, or just finished that would have benefited from the IRA incentives tied to good labor standards.
This was a huge chance to raise pay and improve job quality for clean energy workers nationwide.
Estimates show that without these tax credits, $522 billion in planned clean energy investments are now at risk.
More than $263 billion of this is wind, solar, and energy storage facilities, while $110 billion of announced clean energy manufacturing is at risk.
They are lifelines for working families and for working-class communities.
Yet, this administration has prioritized tax cuts for billionaires over support for everyday Americans, leaving families struggling to make ends meet in an increasingly difficult economy.
Now is the time to invest in families, create jobs, and invest in a clean energy future.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EDITH NOURSE ROGERS STEM SCHOLARSHIP OPPORTUNITY ACT
statements.title: EDITH NOURSE ROGERS STEM SCHOLARSHIP OPPORTUNITY ACT
sentences: Madam Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill, the Edith Nourse Rogers STEM Scholarship Opportunity Act.
Madam Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: They would have been transformative, reducing emissions for this plant by 99 percent.
It is about protecting community health, and it is about growing good-paying union jobs.

Instead of investing in cleaner facilities, healthier communities, and good-paying jobs, they are pulling resources away from businesses making real commitments to reinvest locally and, ultimately, from the American people.
Mr. Chair, I rise in strong opposition to this legislation because it strips away critical resources from projects that directly benefit my district.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RETIREMENT OF MAYOR TYRONE ECHOLS
statements.title: RETIREMENT OF MAYOR TYRONE ECHOLS
sentences: Before he was elected mayor, Mayor Echols worked as a city alderman, a union steward for the International Union of Operating Engineers, and a legislative aide to the State Representative Jim McPike.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IMPROVING VA TRAINING FOR MILITARY SEXUAL TRAUMA CLAIMS ACT
statements.title: IMPROVING VA TRAINING FOR MILITARY SEXUAL TRAUMA CLAIMS ACT
sentences: Right now, contracted disability compensation examiners are only required to complete outdated online sensitivity training before handling these deeply sensitive claims.
That is why I introduced this bipartisan legislation to ensure the VA's claims process supports rather than retraumatizes survivors of MST.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CLEAR COMMUNICATION FOR VETERANS CLAIMS ACT
statements.title: CLEAR COMMUNICATION FOR VETERANS CLAIMS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the Clear Communication for Veterans Claims Act, bipartisan legislation that would simplify the Department of Veterans Affairs' correspondence for our Nation's heroes.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this important bill.
